reason: A material single-parent commit reached main outside the governed candidate/PR merge path.
rootCause: Native branch protection is not enforcing candidate-only writes, so a valid content/tooling change could reach the unprotected default branch directly; post-push CI detects the bypass but cannot prevent it.
failedApproach: Treating exact Netlify deployment identity or post-push CI detection as sufficient proof of governed production authority.
provenFix: Preserve the valid delta, start one fresh candidate from the exact affected main SHA, record the recovery state machine-readably, require the normal exact-head delivery gates, merge only the governed candidate, then require exact production readback before closing recovery.
regressionContract: Main Write Integrity must continue to fail closed on material single-parent writes; candidate-only delivery and exact-SHA production verification remain mandatory. Native branch protection is an external hard boundary and must never be inferred from green CI.

blockerState.required_intervention: Complete this governed candidate path and independently verify production authority/readback.

outcomeObligation.expected: Governed provenance for the preserved valid delta and exact production verification
